reviews.text:
I was treated badly for no reason by the imam.
He was telling me to pray very quickly while the masjid was still full after 'Isha. I responded that I hadn't done wudu yet and with a disgusted face and a loud voice he told me to do it fast.
I told him that if he wanted me to close the masjid he could just tell me and I would pray somewhere else. Then he told me to get out of the masjid and start yelling, raise his hand on my face showing that he gonna hit I was confused I came up to him again and asked are u trying to hit me with this hand ?
He said go back to the night club ! I asked him are u under influence you are not stable at all
I was shocked by the guy, and even more shocked when my friend told me he is the imam !!
I'm sure that Iraqi (the imam) has mental health issues because my friend and another decent guy from Libya both told me it's not the first time he picks fights with people coming to pray.
It's really awful that someone representing my religion behaves like that and I didn’t think an imam would ever stoop this low

reviews.name: Ali Khan
reviews.text:
MashaAllah, this mosque is absolutely beautiful, with plenty of space for worshippers. It's a real blessing to have such a welcoming place in the community.

One kind request: please keep the prayer times on the website up to date. Many of us who work are trying to balance deen and dunya, and we rely on the posted times to plan our day. The website listed the first Jumu'ah khutbah at 1:30, but it began at 1:50. Since I had to be at work by 2:30, that didn't leave enough time to finish salah and get there on time.

I'm sure this was an oversight, and I truly appreciate everything the volunteers and administration do. Accurate timings would make a big difference for working community members. JazakAllahu khairan!
